observations: Photo 0 shows a white and black PlayStation 5 Slim console standing vertically on a wooden surface, with a white and black DualSense controller placed in front of it.
Photo 1 shows the same console standing horizontally on the same surface, with the DualSense controller in front.
The console has a glossy finish with visible reflections and some smudges or fingerprints.
The background includes a framed picture on the wall with a music player interface showing 'Love Yourz' by J. Cole.
The console appears to be in a domestic setting, likely a living room or bedroom.
No power cord, cables, or accessories are visible in either photo.
The console's design matches the PS5 Slim model, with a vertical orientation and a black horizontal stripe across the front.

claims.claim: Clean PS5 slim with a pad
claims.evidence: The console appears clean in the photos, but there are smudges and fingerprints visible. The controller looks clean, but no proof of it being the correct model or functional. The 'clean' claim is subjective and not fully verifiable from the photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or menu.

risks.risk: Controller may not be the correct model or may be non-functional
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Console may have been damaged or have water damage not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the console's ports, vents, and back panel, and a video showing the console being powered on and off.

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as power cable, HDMI cable, or USB cable
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the console and controller.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of the controller connecting and functioning.
Close-up photos of the console's ports and back panel.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
